title: Understanding Property Transfers & Deeds Registration
excerpt: A step-by-step overview of conveyancing processes, title deed verifications, and property acquisition safeguards in Zimbabwean real estate.
body:
Acquiring real estate represents a major financial milestone for individuals and corporate entities alike. However, property transfers require strict adherence to statutory conveyancing processes to guarantee valid title ownership and prevent fraudulent transactions.

The conveyancing process in Zimbabwe involves detailed searches at the Deeds Registry, verification of capital gains tax compliance through the Zimbabwe Revenue Authority (ZIMRA), and the preparation of transfer documents by a registered conveyancer.

Key risk mitigation steps include verifying title deed authenticity, inspecting seller identification, and confirming clear municipal rates clearance certificates. Engaging experienced legal representation throughout the acquisition journey ensures full protection against encumbrances and title disputes.
author: Mavula & Co. Conveyancing Dept.
